correction: Publish a crash file under its scanned *.crash name only after its lock is held, and skip a marked crash file only when the last line of a multi-line panic message ends with the re-panic suffix and no continuation line is a nested panic, each guarded by a test (TestCrashOutputCreateWindow, TestParseCrashMarker, TestRecoverPanicMultilineSubprocess and TestNestedPanicAfterRecordedSubprocess).

Recorder::error formats the error only when it can write (Linux, not inert, valid code) and inside catch_unwind, so a panicking Display gives the code as MESSAGE and never unwinds into the app (guard: panicking_display_gives_the_code, error_with_panicking_display_returns); map_location keeps a panic location only under <crate_root>src/, where install_panic_hook (#[track_caller]) derives the root from its caller file, so vendored, remapped std and other workspace crates get none (guard: root_from_the_caller_file, other_files_give_none, vectors rust-panic-vendor-folder, rust-panic-remapped-std, rust-panic-other-workspace-crate, rust-panic-outside-crate-root).
